{{Quote|It's because we work and we work and we don't get greensick. No other mining village on Lanteeb can claim that. They don't know our secret. Not Chukba, not Endvo, not Deebin, not even Trahn.|[[Jaklin]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
'''Trahn''' was a [[Damotite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] village located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lanteeb was occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and Trahn and the rest of Lanteeb's Damotite mining industry was forced to supply the Separatists with large quantities of the [[Ore/Legends|ore]], for use in a [[Damotite bioweapon]] that was being developed by the Confederacy. However, the inhabitants of Chukba were at a disadvantage to those of the rival mining village [[Torbel]], because they did not possess knowledge of how to avoid suffering from the effects of Damotite [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]].
